title: mentha sylvestris var. royleana
intro: Mentha sylvestris var. royleana, commonly known as Wild Peppermint, is a variety of peppermint plant native to the Himalayan region. This plant has been used for centuries to provide relief from various health issues, including digestive problems, nausea, and headaches, due to its numerous health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Wild Peppermint include its ability to relax muscles, reduce inflammation, and act as a natural carminative. The bioactive constituents of this plant include menthol, menthone, and limonene, which contribute to its therapeutic properties.
